subject: embedded_terminal_v1
operator_observation: Terminal -> Start Session -> no visible result

root_cause.mechanism: First-run walkthrough render() unconditionally wrote store panel to the tour step; the async onboarding check could auto-open after the operator navigated, mounting the terminal panel and then forcing panel back to command-center (stage hidden again).

fixes_this_round.summary: WSL distro names decoded as UTF-8 while wsl.exe emits UTF-16LE (NUL-interleaved names).
fixes_this_round.fix: defaultExec selects utf16le for wsl.exe at the command boundary; normalizeWslDistroOutput() re-decodes already-mis-decoded output losslessly; only a leading BOM is normalized.
fixes_this_round.regression: tests/arch/runtime-providers-wsl.test.ts 3/3 (observed NUL-interleaved sample, passthrough, BOM, empty/error states); tests/arch/terminal-session-routes.test.ts 11/11 unchanged

fixes_this_round.summary: After shell exit, the stopped-session branch re-offered OPEN SESSION while the dead xterm stayed rendered (stale terminal surface).
fixes_this_round.fix: terminal-state branch clears the dead terminal through renderSessionEnded before re-rendering open controls.
fixes_this_round.regression: TERM-009 (bounded poll) proves the closed state on every run

fixes_this_round.summary: Provider discovery timeout UX: failure showed a generic error without a retry affordance.
fixes_this_round.fix: Timeouts map to 'Provider discovery timed out (bounded probe). Use REFRESH to retry.' and the existing REFRESH control is re-attached on failure. Checking state 'Probing runtime providers...' was already truthful. No new provider state machine.
fixes_this_round.regression: success path covered by TERM-002; timeout path verified by inspection (bounded probe, existing retry control)

onboarding_invariant.statement: Automatic onboarding may never override explicit operator navigation.
coverage: TERM-001 clicks TERMINAL before the first-run check resolves, waits for the tour to auto-open afterwards, and requires the panel to remain terminal throughout
ONB-001 clicks RESIDENT while the tour is open and requires the panel to remain resident
onboarding_invariant.handoff: Luna #1 onboarding lane: Walkthrough.render() stays navigate-explicit-only; the auto-open path aligns to store.get().panel and never writes it; manual open and BACK/NEXT are the only panel-driving actions.

points: TERM-001 panel opens and stays active (first-run race path)
